title: Name
description: One name the vocabulary lacks: a single token of a notable person's, place's, company's or brand's name, a US Census surname or given name, or a GeoNames place, as data/vocabulary/names.jsonl lists them. Built by pnpm names:build from the sources pinned in tools/dict-build/src/pins.ts; in no tier. The names experiment (phase Q1) admitted the list for one deep run; since phase N4 the list is the names term class (decision D63), carried by the classes artifact and admitted only when a search names the class.

name.description: The search form, folded as the search folds: lowercase, accents to their base letters, nothing else, three letters or more (the names class enters with a floor of three, decision D63). Never a word the dictionary carries.

kind.description: What the name names, from the source that ranks first for it: person, place, company or brand from Wikidata; surname or given from the Census lists; place from GeoNames.

source.description: The source the kind and the trace come from. Where several sources carry the token, `also` lists the rest.

from.description: The label the token was taken from, as the source spells it: an entity's English label, a place's name, or the Census entry.

trace.description: Where it is attested, always public: the Wikidata item, the GeoNames place, or the Census file.

prominence.description: How prominent the source found it: Wikipedia editions with an article (Wikidata), the rank among surnames (Census surnames), the share of the population in percent (Census given names), or the population (GeoNames).

also.description: The other sources that carry the same token, each with its kind.
